title: Code for: The magician's trick with overlapping boxes (a generalization of IMO 2000 Problem 4)
description: Verification scripts accompanying the paper by Madjid Mirzavaziri and Daniel Yaqubi on partitions of [n] into three classes with pairwise disjoint restricted sumsets. The scripts count all such partitions, check the formula 33n^2-117n+9-3(-1)^n, verify the classification of each type, and generate the certificate tables of the appendix.
